name: jcode
tagline: Rust coding agent built for running many parallel sessions in one repository.
description: A Rust terminal coding agent with a swarm mode in which agents spawn teammates, message each other, and warn one another when files they read have changed. It ships as a CLI for macOS, Linux and Windows plus a beta desktop app, and offers optional hosted inference and cloud-session plans.

pricing.notes: The agent is free; optional monthly plans from $10 add inference credit and cloud sessions.
